input.prompt:
ORIGINAL 2D source sheet for an unlockable Sun-Moon support tower in a colorful temple mobile tower-defense game. Tower concept: "Eclipse Lotus". Playful plant-defense cartoon, chunky clean shapes, crisp outlines, saturated gold/teal/indigo palette, soft cel shading, mobile-readable.

Identity: living lotus rooted in a small circular sandstone planter; alternating warm-gold and cool-indigo petals around a teal crystal seed; two floating crescent leaf-orbs circling the flower; emits support light that can alternate between a warm attack-speed buff and cool defensive/status-resistance aura.
Create 5 isolated consistent states:
1 folded dormant lotus,
2 activation/opening,
3 active idle,
4 warm sun pulse,
5 cool moon shield pulse.
No text, no labels, no UI, no extra characters.
